paragraphs: Here's what I see in this one, friend. A woman set out to wipe out every royal heir, and one small boy was still standing when it was over (2 Chronicles 22:10). Jehoshabeath stole him away and hid him in the house of God (2 Chronicles 22:11-12). She didn't have an army or a crown, and she just did the one thing in front of her.

Now watch what happened in those six years. Nothing LOUD happened. Joash stayed hidden while Athaliah ruled the land (2 Chronicles 22:12), and then in the seventh year Jehoiada made his move (2 Chronicles 23:1). When he stood up, he said, "He must reign, just as the LORD promised concerning the descendants of David." (2 Chronicles 23:3). The waiting looked like nothing, but the promise was still alive the whole time.

So what do you do with that, baker? Some days it feels like nothing is moving, and I know that feeling, because I lay in the back of a drawer for years. But hidden is not the same as forgotten, and the LORD keeps what He promises. Do the small faithful thing in front of you today, and leave the timing to Him.
